artworks.title: Stephen Paschasius
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of an elderly man with a prominent nose, deeply set eyes, and a full beard. He is wearing a cap, a coat with a wide collar, and a tunic with vertical pleats. In the background is an oval frame with the words "STEPH PASCHASIVS REGIARVM PATRONVS" around it. The oval has cross-hatching inside and etched patterns outside. At the bottom, there is a decorative scroll with a textual inscription.

artworks.title: Magdalen de Pass
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman from the chest up. She is facing forward, with her head slightly turned to the left, looking directly at the viewer. The woman has delicate features including a rounded face, a proportional nose, and pursed lips. Her hair is covered by a hood that fits snugly around the back of her head. She is wearing an elaborate ruffled collar typical of the early modern period fashion. The clothing is richly textured, featuring dark fabric with visible patterns on the upper garment. There are no visible accessories or objects in her hands. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure in the portrait.

artworks.title: Gabrielle Charlotte Patin
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is positioned slightly turned to her left, with her hands resting on a table where flowers are laid. Her facial features include a delicate face with a calm expression and her hair is styled in an elaborate manner with curls framing her face. She is wearing a dress with intricate detailing, including lace and decorative elements, and a necklace adorns her neck. In the background, there is a window with a peacock visible outside. The elaborate border surrounding the portrait is filled with swirling designs and scriptwork, providing a formal and intricate frame to the central oval image.

artworks.title: Georg Paul Jenisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up seated with his body facing right, holding a book in his right hand on a stand. He has a stern facial expression and is looking directly at the viewer. His hair is shoulder-length, wavy, brown, and he has a mustache and a small goatee. He is wearing a dark robe with a white ruff collar typical of 17th-century fashion. The background is a dark texture that emphasizes the subject. A border surrounds the image with script at the bottom indicating the man’s name and likely some biographical information.

artworks.title: Mary Sidney, Countess of Pembroke
artworks.artist: Burnet Reading after Simon de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper half. The individual faces slightly to the right, holding an open book in front of their chest with both hands. They have an oval-shaped face, fine features, and a serious expression. Their hair is styled in tight curls framing the face. The person wears an elaborate gown with intricate lace details at the neck and shoulders. Strands of pearls or jeweled necklaces are around their neck, and they wear matching earrings. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Mary Sidney, Countess of Pembroke
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing the upper half of a woman facing forward. The woman has a round face with tightly curled hair framing her face. She wears an ornate, lace-trimmed collar, a double-strand pearl necklace, and earrings. Her outfit has an intricate design, indicating richness and skilled craftsmanship. She holds a closed book labeled "DAVID Psalmes" in her left hand. The portrait is enclosed within a decorative oval frame with Latin inscriptions, a crown, and scrolls at the corners. Behind her is an elaborate etched background.

artworks.title: Mary Sidney, Countess of Pembroke
artworks.description: The image features a historical portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is seated, facing forward with her body slightly angled to the left. Her facial expression is calm and composed, with distinct features including wide eyes and a serene mouth. Her hair is styled in a voluminous, curly fashion typical of the era, framing her face elegantly. She is adorned in richly detailed clothing, featuring intricate patterns and luxurious lace ruffles around the neck and sleeves. The woman is wearing a pearl necklace and matching pearl drop earrings, holding a small open book in her hand that shows the text "David Psalma". The background of the image is an ornate oval frame with scrollwork and decorative elements. Text in Latin and English provides context about the individual depicted, identified as Lady Mary Sidney.

artworks.title: Mary Sidney, Countess of Pembroke
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is positioned facing forward with her head slightly turned to the left. She has a serene expression, large almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and full lips. Her hair is styled in a tight coil of curls and adorned with flowers on one side. She wears a detailed garment with puffed sleeves, a draped neckline, and a broach at the center. Around her neck is a double-strand necklace with a pendant. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame surrounded by ornate scrollwork and decorative elements, including a crown motif emblem at the top. The background features intricate linework and ornamental details, including Latin inscriptions around the oval and French text at the bottom.

artworks.title: William Herbert, First Earl of Pembroke
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the chest up, facing slightly to his left. He has a prominent jawline, a pointed mustache, and a neatly trimmed beard. His hair is styled back under a cap with a feather plume. The man wears a high-collared garment with a ruffled lace collar and buttons down the center. A necklace with an oval medallion hangs around his neck. The background is plain and dark, and the oval frame around the portrait includes text around the edges.

artworks.title: Henry Herbert, Second Earl of Pembroke
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing the upper body and face of a man in a forward-facing position. He has a mustache and a goatee, short well-styled hair, and wears a hat with a large plume. He is dressed in a high-collared garment with ruffled lace, a buttoned coat, and a pendant around his neck. The background has an oval frame with inscriptions, set against a textured backdrop, giving the impression of a traditional portrait design.

artworks.title: William Herbert, Third Earl of Pembroke
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman or Lucas Vorsterman II
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man directly facing the viewer. He has distinctive facial features including a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, a mustache, and a goatee. His curly hair frames his face and extends outward. He is wearing an elaborately embroidered dark coat with a high, white lace collar, and an earring in his right ear. He also wears a chain with a medallion around his neck. The portrait is in an oval frame with the engraving "UNG IE SERVIRAY" at the top. The background has a dark cross-hatched texture.

artworks.title: William, Earl of Pembroke
artworks.artist: Robert van Voerst, after Daniel Mytens the Elder
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man depicted from the waist up, slightly oriented to the left. He has well-defined facial features, curly hair, a mustache, and a beard. He wears a large lace ruff collar typical of early 17th-century fashion. His clothing is richly detailed with textured fabric, possibly silk, featuring intricate designs. He also wears a round pendant on a chain around his neck and an earring in his left ear. The background is a blank oval frame, surrounded by an outer border inscribed with text.

artworks.title: Thomas Percy
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a man with a long face, pointed beard, mustache, and medium-length curly hair. He wears a broad-brimmed hat with a decorative band, a cape with a high collar, and tassels. The background is plain with a horizontal line across the upper part. Below the portrait is text identifying the person as "Tho: Percy, one of the Conspirators in the Gunpowder Plot," with a small printed note indicating the engraver as Adam. The image is on textured, off-white paper with aging effects like small spots.

artworks.title: Thomas Percy
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in a semi-profile position. He has a bearded face with a long mustache and pointed beard, long wavy hair, and wears a wide-brimmed hat with a feather. He is dressed in an embellished tunic with a high collar and a sash across his chest. The background features an oval frame with engraved text around it.

artworks.title: Thomas Percy
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing the head and upper torso of a man facing right. He wears a wide-brimmed hat with a feather. He has a moustache, beard, and shoulder-length curly hair. The man wears a collared coat with visible buttons. An ornate oval frame surrounds him with decorative embellishments, smaller oval scenes above and below the portrait, and Latin text. The background inside the frame is textured.

artworks.title: Thomas Percy
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait of a man in profile, facing to the right. The man is seated, with his upper torso and head visible within an ornate oval frame. He has a strong nose, a full, curly beard and mustache, and curly, shoulder-length hair mostly hidden by a wide-brimmed hat with a ribbon and a brooch. He is wearing a ruffled collared garment. The oval frame is decorated with motifs, including mythical creatures and vignettes. Below the portrait is a Latin inscription, and the background is decorated paper. A plain margin surrounds the image with publication information at the bottom.

artworks.title: Thomas Percy
artworks.description: The image is a historic portrait engraving showing only the upper body of a man in profile. The man is wearing a large, wide-brimmed hat with a decorative embellishment. His facial features include a prominent mustache and a small goatee. He has long, wavy hair that falls below his hat, and his expression is neutral. His clothing includes a detailed doublet with a high collar and intricate lace trim. Encircling the portrait is an ornamental oval frame with various decorations. The background within the oval and the surrounding illustrations is a richly detailed, engraved artwork. Below the main oval are lines of text in Latin. The entire piece is positioned on a lightly aged paper background.

artworks.title: Thomas Percy, Gunpowder Plot Conspirator
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring an upper-body portrait of Thomas Percy. He is centered and facing forward, with a pointed mustache and beard. His hair is styled in curls falling around his shoulders, partly covered by a wide-brimmed hat with a large feather. He wears a high-collared garment with neckline embellishments. Surrounding him are text blocks and two circular illustrations at the bottom depicting armed men in historical military attire with spears, set against fortress-like structures. The background has German and Latin text providing historical context. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by Thomas Percy.

artworks.title: William Perkins, Puritan Divine
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man sitting upright. His facial features include a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, and a full mustache and beard with a hint of gray. The man's hair is closely cropped. He is dressed in period attire, consisting of a layered robe with a high, ruffled collar and buttons down the front. In his hands, he holds an open book with an ornate cover featuring a floral pattern. The background is a textured surface that suggests depth and contrast, with a caption in Latin beneath the portrait.

artworks.title: Sir John Perrot, Deputy of Ireland
artworks.description: The image features an illustration of a man depicted from the waist up. The man is facing forward with his body slightly angled to his left. He has a full beard, a mustache, and short, neatly styled hair with a cap topped with a decorative plume. He is dressed in period clothing, including a high-collared shirt with a distinctive ruffle, a buttoned doublet with rich texture, and a cloak fastened with a cord draped over his shoulder. His hand rests on his hip, and he wears a large, ornate pendant around his neck. The background contains a shaded oval frame with heraldic emblems, including a lion and battlement in the upper right corner, and a bird emblem on a branch in the upper left corner. The caption below the figure identifies him as Sir John Perrott, Deputy of Ireland, with a publication date of January 1, 1776.

artworks.title: Petavius (?)
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust of a man within an ornate oval frame on a textured background. The man faces slightly left with distinct facial features, including deep-set eyes and a neat beard. He wears a buttoned garment with a high collar. Surrounding him are decorative elements like winged figures, scrollwork, inscriptions, and symbols.

artworks.title: Petrus Henriquez
artworks.description: The image is a close-up portrait engraving showing only the upper torso of a man. He is positioned facing slightly to his left with a stern expression. He has prominent cheekbones and a chiseled jaw, short wavy hair, a neatly trimmed beard, and mustache. He wears an ornate clothing piece with a stiff lace ruff around his neck and detailed armored clothing. The portrait is encased in an oval frame against a plain textured background. Below the image is a rectangular plaque that reads "PETRUS HENRIQUEZ, GRAEF VAN FUENTES ETC."

artworks.title: Philibert, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a person from the waist up. They are standing with one hand on their hip and the other holding a baton-like object. The individual has facial hair, short wavy hair, and is wearing a ruffled collar and a dark detailed doublet or coat. They also wear a necklace with a medallion. The background shows a tree, foliage, and cloudy sky on the left, with a scene of figures on horseback in the distance behind the person.
